fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat (2020 Chaparral 19 SSI bowrider) with trailer.
findings: Bow and cockpit vinyl upholstery looks clean and bright with no visible staining or mildew
Gelcoat on the bow deck and gunwales appears glossy with no visible chalking
Dash, helm and console look clean and free of grime
Snap-in flooring in the cockpit looks clean
Rear sun pad and transom area look clean; hull sides below the rub rail are not shown, so the waterline can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2020 Chaparral 19 SSI, and it looks like it's been well kept, with clean upholstery and good gloss on the deck. If you'd like it at its best for showings, we do a mobile pre-sale wash and wax, and we can check the hull and waterline at the same time. Would you like a quote?
